review_text: Nice place to eat and rest for a while...food is good and priced reasonably. Would like to suggest they offer fruit in season shakes for non coffee drinkers. Friendly staff.

A little gem of a place. Modern, bright and clean. The coffee was as good as any I've had in Davao. And most importantly the service was excellent. The owner/manager was lovely. Very bubbly and friendly and her assistant was also very efficient. Would happily come here again. Please have Sikwate in your menu.😊
